values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov. The NPS record counts 74 reservable and 14 first-come sites but also says all sites in all loops must be reserved; recreation.gov says the campground is first-come in winter, while its rate table now sells 'Peak Season' through March 31, 2027. 14 consecutive nights, 30 days a year; 8 people and 2 vehicles per site; 2 sites per booking.

note: Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP campground on the South Rim, a mile from the South Rim Visitor Center; sites fairly close together, partly shaded by tall scrub oak. Loop B is the electric loop. After the 2025 South Rim Fire only limited non-electric sites are open in 2026, electric hookups are unavailable and some areas are closed (NPS, 2026-10-27). No generators; no firewood collection or sales. --Claude
